evidence.note: Four content columns share one viewport: a numbered step list on the left, a diagram card in the centre, a stack of three quote cards on the right, plus the title and a caption at the bottom.
The step list restates the same three stages (Return request, Warehouse, Refund) that the diagram shows, so the two elements carry the same message twice.
At the small size the three quote cards sit tightly beside the diagram card, and the caption wraps under the step list. Nothing overlaps, but the space is noticeably tighter.
The large diagram card is empty at step 0, and wide empty bands remain to the right of the title and under the diagram. There is whitespace, but it is not used to give the content room.

rationale: The slide keeps clear gaps and nothing overlaps, so it is not crammed. But it puts a step list, a diagram and a quote column side by side, and the list duplicates the diagram, which is more elements than the message needs. That matches level 2 (busy) and resembles the rejected anchor's composition, laid out with more air.
